{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any invalid revenue values
print("Invalid revenue values (non-numeric or negative):")
print(sales_df[~sales_df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float)))])

# Check for negative revenue
print("\nNegative revenue values:")
print(sales_df[sales_df['revenue'] < 0])

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the channel distribution
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Compute total revenue per channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print("\nTotal revenue by channel:")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Check if any channel has no completed orders
for channel in ['email', 'paid_search']:
    if channel not in sales_df['channel'].unique():
        print(f"Channel {channel} has no completed orders.")"}
